The game responds to C ("no-bench"). So the game is live. Movement is the only broken thing.

Let me reconsider: "crafting needs the workbench in front of you." So I need to be adjacent to the workbench at (10,5) and face it. But I can't move.

The core problem: I cannot move at all. Let me try one more thing — maybe the movement requires the tile to be truly free and the notice board at my tile is blocking. Let me try to see if there's a way to "step off" — perhaps holding a direction while the game re-evaluates. 

Let me try holding direction for 10 seconds.
